Simulo

Simulo is my multiplayer sandbox game, built in a custom TypeScript game engine, and rendered with the Bevy Rust game engine.

This project was a rewrite of a previous iteration of Simulo, which was a Bevy game with Lua scripting.

Simulo on Steam

Realtime SDF-SDF Collision

SDF-SDF collision allows for detailed deformable objects to collide with eachother. Algodoo is an example of a physics application that uses this type of collision.

I reverse-engineered their collision algorithm and implemented a 2D demo of it in Rust. The same technique would translate perfectly to 3D.

Online Demo

Simulo UI Redesign

This is an unreleased redesign of Simulo's main menu and UI.

All icons used are custom, as well as the player 3D model.

Bevy Editor Mockup

This was a mockup I made of what an editor for the Bevy game engine could look like. It was made in HTML+CSS, and was featured on the Bevy website's blog.
